ECF 9.title: Defendant's Motion for Protective Order
ECF 9.ask: Deny the motion; the movant has not shown good cause with specific facts.

in_case_orders.title: Order on emergency motion to compel
in_case_orders.excerpt: ORDER granting in part and denying in part [10] EMERGENCY MOTION to Compel Discovery.
in_case_orders.use: The Court already compelled production on overlapping requests; the protective order would undo that ruling.

authorities.holding: A protective order requires good cause and a certification of a good-faith conference.
authorities.quote: The court may, for good cause, issue an order to protect a party or person from annoyance, embarrassment, oppression, or undue burden or expense
authorities.use: Hold the movant to the good-cause and conference requirements.
